texts.preamble: Ram Chandra Agarwal vs The State Of Jharkhand Through Deputy ... on 31 August, 2022 Author: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi Bench: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi W.P.(Cr.)No.327 of 2021 ---- Ram Chandra Agarwal, aged about 30 years, son of Ramesh Agarwal, resident of House Number 113, Nh-33, Village Charchaka, Near Baba Hotel, Dhalbhumgarh, P.O. Dhalbhumgarh, P.S. Dhalbhumgarh, District East Singhbhu ..... Petitioner -- Versus -- 1.The State of Jharkhand through Deputy Commissioner, Jamshedpur, having its office at Jamshedpur, P.O. Mango, P.S. Sakchi, District East Singhbhum 2.The Sub Divisional Officer cum Designated Officer, having its Office at Dhalbhum, P.O. Mango, P.S. Sakchi, District East Singhbhum 3.Food Safety Officer, Jamshedpur having its office at Jamshedpur, Po Mango and Ps Sakchi, District East Singhbhum ...... Opposite Parties ---- Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi --- For the Petitioner :- Mr. Indrajit Sinha, Advocate For the State :- Mrs. Vandana Singh, Sr.S.C.-III ---- 6/31.08.2022
texts.arguments: Mrs. Vandana Singh, the learned counsel appearing for the respondent State submits that supplementary counter affidavit dated 22.8.2022 has been filed in which all the relevant annexures of sanction and prosecution have been brought on record.
